name: J. D. Ford
summary:
James David Ford (born November 6, 1982) is an American politician, currently a member of the Indiana Senate. He is the representative-elect for Indiana's 5th congressional district, defeating Republican incumbent Victoria Spartz in the general election in 2026.
Elected to the state senate in 2018, he represents District 29, including portions of Carmel, Zionsville and Indianapolis as a member of the Democratic Party.
